label: Lucrezia Cortigiani
roles: wife of ser Piero da Vinci
summary: Fourth wife of ser Piero, married c.1485 to 1487; outlived him.

value.text: Fourth wife of ser Piero, married c.1485 to 1487; outlived him.

claims.statement: Lucrezia di Guglielmo Cortigiani married ser Piero about 1485 to 1487 and bore him several children; she survived him in 1504. A draft letter by Leonardo addressing a 'carissima e dolce madre' is often read as addressed to her, which is an interpretation.
